intro.headingText: A waterfront quarter of Port Harcourt, reimagined as a single

pillars.title: Nowhere else
pillars.body: An upside-down attraction built from a concept with no precedent anywhere in the world — designed, not adapted from something already open elsewhere.

pillars.title: Grounds, not a park
pillars.body: Nine distinct quarters connected by water, walkways and green — built to be explored over a day, not queued through in an hour.

pillars.title: Built for return visits
pillars.body: A resident membership, curated F&B, and a beach club designed around the people who will come back every weekend, not once.

flagship.heading: The world,
flagship.body: An upside-down attraction built from a concept with no equivalent anywhere else — every room, corridor and fixture inverted, gravity reasoned through rather than simulated.

ring.title: The Ring
ring.intro: A circular attraction floor at the centre of the grounds. Scroll to move through it — six spaces arranged around a single walking loop.

items.title: Hologram Zoo
items.body: A 3D immersive experience built to put guests inside the wild, not just in front of it.

items.title: Arcade & Bumper Cars
items.body: Full-format arcade floor paired with a dedicated bumper car circuit.

items.title: Kids Club
items.body: The grounds' largest single space — supervised, self-contained, built for full-day stays.

items.title: Skating
items.body: A dedicated rink inside the ring — outside the original activity brief, included here because it sits directly on the phase-one footprint.

items.title: Seafood Restaurant
items.body: Sit-down dining at the centre of the ring, between the water feature and the attraction floor.

items.title: ATV Area
items.body: A dedicated track — also outside the original brief, flagged for the same reason as Skating.

green.title: The Green
green.intro: 1,860 sqm concert area anchoring an open-air adventure quarter. Scroll on to move through the rest of it.

items.title: Wall Climbing & Rope Course
items.body: A vertical course paired with a rope circuit. Bungee jump is under review — not yet sited on the current plan.

items.title: Padel Court
items.body: A dedicated court, sited beside the football pitch on the grounds' southern edge.

items.title: 5-a-side Football
items.body: Full-size five-a-side pitch, adjoining the padel court.

items.title: Archery & Shooting Range
items.body: Included per your brief, but not yet allocated a footprint on the site plan we're working from.

waterfront.title: The Waterfront
waterfront.intro: The full beach club complex, its lounges and open water — set apart from the ring, reached along its own approach from the water body.
features: Club and lounge — two rooms, one for day one for night.
Adult and kids pools, held separate from the ring behind.
Spa, kitchen and bar service running through the whole approach.
waterfront.callout: An inflatable course anchored offshore — timed runs, team heats, open swim sessions between them.

gallery.title: The Jetty Restaurant
gallery.tag: Dining built out over open water

fnbMarketplace.heading: A curated line-up,
fnbMarketplace.body: One seafood house is confirmed. The remaining vendor slots are held open — each will carry a single, distinct kitchen rather than a repeated format.

tickets.heading: Visit us,
tickets.body: Buy in advance or add at the gate. Family packages held aside for weekends; day-passes to the beach club open daily. Availability confirmed by email — no card charged until you confirm.

items.name: Adult day entry
items.body: Full grounds access — walk the ring, the green and the waterfront approach at your own pace.

items.name: Child day entry
items.body: Same access as adult entry. Children under 4 free with a paying adult.

items.name: Family day entry
items.body: Four-person family pass — best value for a full day out.

items.name: Upside-Down Ship walkthrough
items.body: Timed entry into the ship — every room, corridor and fixture inverted.

items.name: ATV circuit lap
items.body: Fifteen minutes on the dedicated circuit. Helmet and briefing included.

items.name: Padel court
items.body: Full court, one hour, up to four players. Rackets available on site.

items.name: Jet ski · 15 min
items.body: Fifteen-minute ride along the marked approach — guided or self-run.

items.name: Inflatable course heat
items.body: Timed run on the offshore inflatable course. Open swim between heats.

items.name: Family day package
items.body: Entry, one activity per person, and a table at the seafood house for four.

items.name: Birthday package
items.body: Full day out — entry, three attractions per guest, party space at the kids club, and cake.

items.name: Corporate day out
items.body: For teams — grounds entry, choice of two activities, and lunch at the seafood house.

items.name: Beach club day pass
items.body: Full-day access to the beach club, both lounges, and the adult pool.

items.name: Beach club · couples
items.body: Two day passes plus a reserved cabana half-day and welcome drinks.

items.name: Private cabana
items.body: Private cabana on the beach club deck. Table service through the afternoon.

citizenApp.heading: The grounds,
citizenApp.body: Buy tickets, hold your day pass and check what's open — all from one app. Citizens save 10% on every ticket, room and package booked in-app, plus first look at weekend slots.

features.label: 10% off every ticket
features.body: Grounds entry, activities, packages and beach passes — always cheaper in-app.

features.label: Priority slots
features.body: First look at weekend cabanas, concert dates and flagship walkthrough windows.

features.label: Your visit, held together
features.body: All your bookings, your host contact, and directions inside the grounds — one screen.

overlap.imageAlt: Wide coastal shore at low light
overlap.caption: The grounds meet open water along a curated approach — beach, jetty and cabana leisure held to a single edge.

panorama.heading: A single loop, from ring to shore.
panorama.imageAlt: Aerial view of the grounds sweeping toward the water

chapters.title: The Ring
chapters.body: Attractions floor at the centre of the grounds — six spaces on one walking loop.

chapters.title: The Green
chapters.body: Concert lawn, courts and adventure quarter along the southern edge.

chapters.title: The Waterfront
chapters.body: Beach club, jetty dining and the offshore inflatable course.

rooms.heading: Rooms held close to the
rooms.body: A limited number of stays across the grounds — each within a short walk of the ring, the green or the shore. Room count is deliberately small; occupancy is managed against membership demand.

items.name: Waterfront Suite
items.body: A first-floor suite along the jetty approach — private balcony, direct sight-line to the open water and the beach club deck below.

items.name: Grove Loft
items.body: Loft-style room set into the green edge of the grounds. Quieter side of the site, morning light through tall windows, steps from the courts and concert lawn.

items.name: Ring Studio
items.body: Compact studio directly above the attractions ring — for guests who want to be in the middle of everything, not at the edge of it.

items.name: Beach Cabana
items.body: Private cabana along the beach club approach — day-use only, includes deck, shade and dedicated table service through the afternoon.

reveal.imageAlt: Aerial view of the grounds and waterfront
reveal.heading: Return to the water.
reveal.subheading: The waterfront is where the grounds open up — the beach club, the jetty and the swim course all sit along a single approach from the shore.

siteMap.heading: Three zones, one loop.
siteMap.caption: Simplified for orientation — not drawn to the scale of the construction plan.

visit.heading: Come see us.
visit.body: Walk-ins are welcome across the grounds. For table bookings, group visits or membership enquiries, get in touch.
visit.formSuccessBody: We've received your enquiry and will get back to you shortly.
